{{Top|leg}}
'''V'Bren Goh''' was a small [[lake]] located near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Graith]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Its name literally meant "Bitter Tarn" in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. [[Water/Legends|Water]] from the V'Bren Goh was used in Graith, but only after being filtered and purified.
